act_info.act_name: Premium Morning Level-Up  Auto Reward Part 1&2- Jan 2026

textContent.value: 🌟 Introducing the Premium Morning Level-Up Rebate Auto Reward Event! 🌟
Once you click Sign Up and select a date, you will be automatically enrolled in three time slots on that date. This gives you a longer window to go live and earn more beans!

🕒 Event Run Time: 
4:00 AM - 7:00 AM
7:00 AM - 10:00 AM

Daily Task: 
lv.1 if 2,000 beans recevied, get 1,400 beans reward
lv.2 - if 3,000 beans received, get extra 600 beans reward
lv.3 - if 4,000 beans received, get extra 300 beans reward
lv.4 - if 5,000 beans received, get extra 100 beans reward
The maximum reward you can receive is 2,400 beans
First come, First serve! The first 1,000 hosts complete the task will get reward

🆕In-room Recharge Daily Leaderboard: 
Everyone signed up the event will compete in a daily leaderboard!
1 In-room Recharge Diamond = 1 Point
Get more In-room Recharge within the event period and win more Beans Reward
👉 In-room recharge refers to the recharge behavior that happens inside the live room.
Top 1 will receive 10,000 beans as reward
Top 2 will receive 5,000 beans as reward
Top 3 will receive 2,000 beans as reward
Top 4-10 will receive 100 beans as reward

🆕In-room Recharge Daily Leaderboard

Everyone signed up the event will compete in a daily leaderboard!

1 In-room Recharge Diamond = 1 Point

Get more In-room Recharge within the event period and win more Beans Reward

👉 In-room recharge refers to the recharge behavior that happens inside the live room.
💫 Don't miss out on this opportunity to level up your mornings and earn exciting rewards. Join the event now and let's make every morning extraordinary!
